thread:
Alex M: Quick postmortem follow-up from the billing outage yesterday — delayed metering spike led to undercounted tokens for ~3 hours. We need owners and timelines for fixes and customer remedies.
Samira R: Thanks — I captured notes during the RCA. Short version: aggregator laged when the write queue backed up, batching TTL expired and some batches were dropped.
Ben T: Confirmed — affected window ~02:10–05:25 UTC. Estimated undercount ~8–12% for affected customers.
Claire (ops): ACTION: I'll own the queue retry/resilience work. Plan: add persistent queue + backpressure metrics. ETA: 2 weeks for PR, 4 weeks to rollout.
Hiro: I can take quantification and reconciliation. Will run full token-recount job vs logs and produce per-customer delta file. ETA: 5 business days.
Priya (Finance): We need an invoice correction plan and customer comms. Who can give exact credit numbers once Hiro has deltas?
Hiro: I'll hand off CSV to Priya and Ben once job completes. I'll include confidence buckets (high/medium/low).
billing-bot: invoice-corrections: queued 34 invoices for manual review. (automated note)
Alex M: Nice. Also need monitoring + alerts to detect future delayed-metering regressions. Suggest SLOs on ingestion lag and a synthetic metering test.
Claire (ops): Adding an alert to PagerDuty if ingestion lag > 2m for >5m. I’ll add synthetic test to the daily canary. ETA: 3 days for alert, 1 week for canary.
Samira R: For root cause: we saw periodic GC spikes on aggregator pod due to a large ephemeral allocation pattern from the tokenizer service. Fix options: reduce allocations (preferred) or bump resources.
Ben T: Recurring pattern? We had a similar blip 6 weeks ago but auto-recovered. Might be the same tokenizer change rolled last month.
Alex M: ACTION: Samira to coordinate with ML infra to get a patch; Ben to run a diff of deploys around that timeframe. Owners + ETA?
Samira R: I'll open a patch PR today and request expedited review. ETA: 4 days to patch, 2 days to validate in staging.
Ben T: I'll run deploy diff and link commits by EOD.
Priya (Finance): For customer-facing steps: 1) expedite reconciles, 2) prepare provisional credits, 3) send targeted emails to impacted accounts with apology + credit. I'd like to own the email copy with Solutions.
Alex M: Priya + Solutions for copy; Ben + Hiro provide numbers; Claire ops to confirm system fix schedule for the note.
Priya (Finance): I'll draft copy and share in #customer-success for review. Target send window after Hiro's reconciliation completes.
Hiro: Reconciliation job plan: 1) replay ingestion logs -> authoritative token count, 2) compare to billed counts, 3) output deltas + confidence. Running first pass tonight.
Samira R: Safety measure: we should add a short-term hedging policy — if lag > threshold, system should route to fallback metering that counts tokens per-request (slower but accurate) until backlog clears. I can prototype in 1 week.
Alex M: Good. Also need a postmortem doc with action items, owners, and follow-up meeting in one week to verify progress and watch for recurrence.
Claire (ops): Scheduled follow-up: Thu 15:00 UTC next week. I'll post calendar invite.
Ben T: FYI I found the tokenizer rollout that introduced larger allocations. Rolling back that patch reproduced the GC behaviour in staging.
Samira R: Ok rollback queued if patch review is delayed.
Priya (Finance): Billing ops note: hold off on issuing automated refunds. Wait for Hiro's delta CSV + manual QA. We'll apply credits in one batch to avoid duplicate adjustments.
Hiro: First-pass CSV will be ready tomorrow morning. Will include reconciliation notes and confidence flags.
Alex M: Recap of owners/timelines: Claire = queue resilience + alerts (3 days/2 weeks), Samira = tokenizer patch & fallback (4 days/1 week), Hiro = reconciliation CSV (1 day), Ben = deploy diff + assist (EOD), Priya = invoice policy + customer comms (after CSV).
Claire (ops): Adding these to the incident postmortem doc and assigning trackers.
Samira R: One more ask — can Eng SRE run a weekly metering audit for 6 weeks to surface any repeats? Alex, can you loop them in?
Alex M: Will loop eng-sre and schedule weekly audit for the next 6 weeks.
Priya (Finance): After credits, I'll prepare a short memo for Finance leadership with expected revenue impact and list of impacted customers.
Ben T: I'll tag the tokenizer PRs and add a note to change log to prevent reintroducing the bad allocation pattern.
Alex M: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene at the follow-up. If anything slips, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Priya (Finance): Thanks — appreciate the quick coordination.
billing-bot: reminder: follow-up meeting Thu 15:00 UTC (automated)
